name: Radio
title: Radio
summary: A 20px radio button with a 6px Horizon Blue ring when selected, used in a fieldset group where exactly one option can be picked.
whenToUse: 2–5 options, only one can be picked, and all should stay visible (gift frequency, "How did you hear about ISM?").
Card-style rows (`.check` + `.fm-radio`) when each option needs a one-line description (partnership type).
More than 5 options: use Select. Several can be picked: use Checkbox. Two options that switch a view or price (one-time / monthly): use SegmentedControl.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. Short and parallel with the other options.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of this option. Required inside a `RadioGroup`.

props.name: card
props.description: Render as a full-width `.check` row card; `children` becomes the title.

props.name: description
props.description: One-line explanation. In a card it sits under the title; in a plain row it follows the label (for example "(coming soon)" on a disabled option).

props.name: value
props.description: Value reported to the group when selected.

props.name: description
props.description: One-line explanation under the label (card variant) or beside it (row variant, e.g. "(coming soon)").

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state when used without a `RadioGroup`.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when pressed when used without a `RadioGroup`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `row` is a 44dp row; `card` is a bordered row with a description.

variantNotes: Default: 1.5px `rgba(0,0,0,.4)` ring on white; hover turns it black.
Focus: 2px `--horizon-blue` outline, 2px offset, `--shadow-focus` (`.fm-focus` draws it statically).
Error: `aria-invalid="true"` on every radio in the group, `--error` ring on `--error-bg`; one `.err` under the group.
Card row: `.check` turns `--horizon-blue` border on `--blue-tint` when its radio is checked; `.check.fm-disabled` greys out.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always wrap a group in `<fieldset>` + `<legend>`; the legend asks the question.
Pre-select the most common safe choice (e.g. Monthly) only when it is not a commitment the person did not choose; never pre-select in surveys.
Stack options vertically; go horizontal (`.fm-radios`, 3 columns) only for short labels inside FormLayout.
Keep the 44px row height; do not shrink the circle below 20px.
Explain disabled options in a hint ("coming soon", "Opens in 2027").
One error message per group, not per radio.

accessibility: Same `name` on every radio in a group. Arrow keys move and select; Tab enters and leaves the group.
Link the group error with `aria-describedby` on the fieldset.
Do not rely on colour alone: the selected ring is thicker as well as blue.
content: Legend as a question: "How often would you like to give?", "How did you hear about ISM?".
Options short and parallel: "HD Radio broadcast", "The dot.Bible app", "A friend or church".
